comments: Input facts: ego and agent1 are cars; ego initiates lateral incursion and agent1 responds; both initially travel in different lanes of the same trafficway. Chosen assumptions: a compact urban two-lane corridor; ego catches a slower car ahead in the left lane and merges left behind it after 0.6 s. Agent1 responds to ego entering its lane within 15 m by applying throttle until separation reaches 20 m, then following its lane at 11-12 m/s to open the gap. Speeds are m/s, distances are m, and times are s. This is a rear-quarter closure rather than a lead cut-in; collision is not required.
